clue.text: Forestall an involuntary movement, one with head

parts.note: a tic is an involuntary twitch of a muscle
the Roman numeral for one is I
pate is an old word for the head

explanation.surface: Someone heads off a sudden twitch by a nod of the head.
explanation.definitionFit: To forestall is to act first to prevent something, which is what acting in expectation of it amounts to.

clue.text: Maid employed partly as assistant

indicators.note: partly says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A maid taken on as a part-time helper.
explanation.definitionFit: An aide is a helper or assistant, especially to an official.

clue.text: Monument to doctor…

parts.note: MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A memorial raised to a physician, the sentence trailing into the next clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A tomb is a burial structure, often a grand memorial to the dead.

clue.text: … timid man, but firm with section of hospital

parts.note: Co. is the abbreviation for company, a firm
a ward is a room or section of a hospital

explanation.surface: Continuing from the doctor: a nervous man who is nonetheless resolute about a hospital ward.
explanation.definitionFit: A coward is a person lacking courage, a fearful man.

clue.text: Dreadful occasion-I helped give lethal cup

indicators.note: dreadful suggests something messed up, so the letters that follow are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone recalls a terrible event at which they helped hand over a deadly drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dreadful' shuffles the letters of OCCASION, I and HELPED. The answer is also an idiom for an honour that brings trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A poisoned chalice is literally a goblet of poisoned wine, a cup that kills.

clue.text: Essays: the ones here got a second

parts.note: these means the ones close at hand
s is the abbreviation for a second of time

explanation.surface: A teacher remarks that the essays in front of them earned a second-class mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Theses are long academic dissertations, extended pieces of argued writing.

clue.text: Bit of cotton wool was horribly black

indicators.note: horribly suggests the letters of the word was are mangled into a new order

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Someone's piece of cotton wool came out filthy black.
explanation.definitionFit: A swab is a pad of absorbent material used for cleaning or taking samples.

clue.text: Everyone on the way to support western financial centre

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece that supports is written beneath, so the western letter sits above the rest

parts.note: all means everyone
a street is a road or way

explanation.surface: Everyone is on their way to back a western banking district.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'to support' means the letters for everyone and the way stand under W; 'on' just joins those two.
explanation.definitionFit: Wall Street in New York is home to the stock exchange and stands for American finance.

clue.text: Reverie of Chesterton's detective

definitions.meaning: a reverie is a state of daydreaming, being lost in thought
G.K. Chesterton's detective is the priest Father Brown, so a room belonging to him would be his study

explanation.surface: A daydream belonging to a famous fictional sleuth.
explanation.definitionFit: Being lost in thought or absorbed in meditation is an old idiom for a dreamy state; the second reading is the room of the priest-sleuth.

clue.text: It may give the meal a bit of lift

definitions.text: It may give the meal a bit of lift

parts.words: It may give the meal a bit of lift
parts.note: reads like a sauce that perks up dinner, but describes a small service elevator that literally raises food between floors

explanation.surface: Something that adds a little zest to dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: A small hoist carrying food from a kitchen to an upper dining room literally lifts the meal.

clue.text: Boy to become a singer

parts.note: Al is a short boy's name

explanation.surface: A lad aspires to become a vocalist.
explanation.definitionFit: An alto is a singer with a low female or high male voice.

clue.text: One representative allows people in to get items of equipment

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
an MP, Member of Parliament, is an elected representative

indicators.note: in says the word for people goes inside the word for allows

parts.note: lets means allows
men means people

explanation.surface: A lone delegate lets folk in to collect tools.
explanation.definitionFit: Implements are tools or utensils, the gear used for a task.

clue.text: Awesome, as a lot is?

definitions.meaning: awesome in its old sense of daunting, threatening, grim
a lot at an auction is put up so people may make offers on it

explanation.surface: Something impressive, like a large quantity.
explanation.definitionFit: Forbidding means stern and menacing, inspiring awe or dread; an auction lot is up for offers from buyers.

clue.text: Soldier finds nothing in report brought back

indicators.note: in says the letter for nothing is placed inside the turned word
brought back says the word report is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: taken as written before it is turned
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A soldier discovers that a returned report contains nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought back' turns REPORT into TROPER, and 'in' puts O inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A trooper is a private soldier, especially in a cavalry or armoured unit.

clue.text: Riot control agent 'as great possibilities

indicators.note: possibilities hints at the various arrangements the letters could take

explanation.surface: A spray for crowds is said, in dialect, to have great potential.
explanation.walkthrough: The dropped-aitch 'as gives the letters A and S.
explanation.definitionFit: Tear gas is a chemical irritant used by police to disperse crowds.

clue.text: Get back-soldiers need protection

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of British soldiers
cover means shelter or protection

explanation.surface: To regain ground, troops need shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: To recover something is to regain it after losing it.

clue.text: Secured mineral supply held by defence ministry

indicators.note: held by says the mineral word sits inside the ministry's letters

parts.note: the MoD is Britain's Ministry of Defence
ore is rock from which a mineral is extracted

explanation.surface: The defence ministry has locked down a supply of minerals.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat is moored when it is made fast with ropes or an anchor.

clue.text: Ocean, boy, is salt

parts.note: an ocean is a sea
a son is a male child, a boy

explanation.surface: A lad declares the ocean is salty.
explanation.definitionFit: To salt food is to flavour it, as with herbs or pepper.

clue.text: Politician is generous to opponent of tyranny

parts.note: liberal means open-handed, generous
a democrat favours rule by the people rather than by a tyrant

explanation.surface: A public figure is kind to someone resisting a dictator.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of the UK's Liberal Democrat party is a politician of the centre.

clue.text: Indian city of very enthusiastic painters

parts.note: mad about something means wildly keen on it
RA is a Royal Academician, a painter, so RAs are painters

explanation.surface: An Indian city known for its passionate artists.
explanation.walkthrough: RA stands for Royal Academician, a member of London's Royal Academy of Arts.
explanation.definitionFit: Madras is the former name of Chennai, a major city on India's east coast.

clue.text: Put ball in play, capturing point by deflection

indicators.note: capturing says the serving word goes around the compass letter

parts.note: to serve in tennis is to start a point by hitting the ball
W, west, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A tennis player's serve wins a point thanks to a ricochet.
explanation.definitionFit: A swerve is a sudden change of direction, a veering aside.

clue.text: Rely on departure before the conclusion

indicators.note: before puts the departure letters ahead of the conclusion

parts.note: dep. is the abbreviation for departure on timetables
the end is the conclusion

explanation.surface: Count on leaving before the finish.
explanation.definitionFit: To depend on someone is to trust or count on them.

clue.text: Run off some notes on military settlement

parts.note: D and E are notes of the musical scale
a camp is a place where troops are stationed

explanation.surface: A few musical notes are played over an army base.
explanation.definitionFit: To decamp is to leave suddenly or secretly, to bolt.

clue.text: Item of clothing for the Cornish consumer?

parts.note: Cornwall is in the far south-west of England, abbreviated SW
an eater is one who consumes food

explanation.surface: A garment for a hungry person from Cornwall.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweater is a knitted pullover, a jumper.

clue.text: Nothing to hold a tack

indicators.note: to hold says the word for nothing wraps round the letter A

parts.note: nil means nothing, zero

explanation.surface: There is nothing to keep a drawing pin in place.
explanation.definitionFit: A tack is a small, short nail with a broad head.

clue.text: Offered this by pick-up truck?

parts.note: a passing vehicle, here one that picks people up, may offer a free ride

explanation.surface: A driver of a pick-up truck makes a hitchhiker an offer.
explanation.definitionFit: A free ride in a passing vehicle is a common British term for being given a car journey.

clue.text: Contortionist's chin covers part of foot

indicators.note: a contortionist twists their body, so the letters of chin are twisted into a new order

explanation.surface: A contortionist's chin reaches down over a section of the foot.
explanation.walkthrough: The foot here is the unit of length, not the body part.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve of this small unit make a foot in imperial measure.

clue.text: Making a priest interrupt address by loud noise

indicators.note: interrupt says the noise breaks into the middle of the speech

parts.note: an oration is a formal speech, an address
a din is a loud racket

explanation.surface: A racket breaks into the sermon at a priest's induction.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordination is the ceremony conferring holy orders on a new member of the clergy.

clue.text: Indicate to put name

definitions.meaning: to point out or show by a gesture or signal
to write one's name on a document

explanation.surface: Show where someone should add their signature.
explanation.definitionFit: A gesture can signal something, and one writes one's autograph on a form.

clue.text: State of enthusiasm always found in loud sales talk?

indicators.note: found in says the word for always sits inside the other letters

parts.note: f, forte, is the musical direction for loud
a sales pitch is persuasive talk
ever means always

explanation.surface: Excitement always runs high in a noisy sales patter.
explanation.definitionFit: Fever pitch is an idiom for a peak of excitement or intensity.
